newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian bourse launches new official list.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian bourse launches new official list.

text.p: The Lithuanian stock exchange on Monday said that its new official list started trading as planned and that it would guarantee more transparency about the companies on the list.
The new official list includes four of the most traded shares: leading banks Hermis Bank and Vilnius, dairy firm Rokishkis Cheese and cardboard producer Medienos Plaushas.
"Trade on the official list started today and we will begin calculating and announcing its index today," bourse deputy chairman Dalia Jasiulaityte told Reuters.
She said the new list would make sure that all the necessary information was provided to investors.
Both local and foreign investors have said they are eager to invest in Lithuanian shares but a lack of information has been a deterring factor.

"The bourse guarantees that it will provide reliable information about the companies on the list and the bourse says that the securities of the companies on the list are liquid and work stably," Jasiulaityte added.

The bourse also calculates two other indices, the Litin A, which is made up of many of the most traded stocks and is much larger than the official list, and the Litin B, which includes most of the rest of the market.
